construct_vector_envs_from_config: construct a VectorEnv from a DictConfig with scenes split across parallel environments
create_parallel_habitat_environments: create parallel Habitat simulation environments with unique seeds and scene assignments per worker
split_scenes_across_environments: split a list of scenes round-robin across multiple parallel environment workers
expand_wildcard_scenes: expand wildcard content_scenes to all available scenes from the Habitat dataset
enable_debug_vector_env: enable debug mode to use ThreadedVectorEnv instead of VectorEnv for slower but inspectable execution
